Second advance and range breakout: pullback low 2358.62 (bar 1789430400000), then bar 1789689600000 closes 2612.02 above the 2557.46 range high and bar 1789948800000 reaches 2850 and closes 2775.61.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2786.81 and then above 2850 on a wide-range bull bar, with the following bar closing higher, would confirm the breakout leg rather than a pause.
Pullback: a close below the four-bar pause low 2633.31 (bar 1790208000000) would put price back under the consolidation and point to a pullback toward the prior range high 2557.46.

Trend change evidence: a close below 2358.62 (bar 1789430400000) would break the higher-low sequence and the approximate double bottom with 2357.18, weakening the Always-In Long read and supporting a larger trading range 2357.18-2850.
Range development: five or more further bars overlapping inside 2633.31-2786.81 without a new high would turn the pause into a trading range at the highs and lower Always-In relevance.

evidence_against: The larger window still prints a higher low at 2358.62 followed by a higher high at 2850.00, and the pullback holds above the 50% level of that leg (2604.31), so these 28 bars can equally be read as a bull flag or pullback within an ongoing bull trend rather than a settled range.

Lows since 1790236800000 are rising (2633.31, 2640.00, 2667.22, 2669.67) and the final bar closes at 2691.88, in the upper part of its own small range, so near-term pressure is not clearly one-sided lower.
